capabilities: Search books by title, author, or ISBN
Select an edition and import its details into the note
Fill properties like publisher, ISBN, and YES24 URL, and insert cover image
Preserve user properties and text outside the generated section
Filter searches between Korean books, foreign books, and ebooks with pagination
extras: The README is mostly Korean with an English usage section. It warns that the plugin depends on YES24's unofficial search API and page structure, which can change, and links to research and verification notes. Requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or later. No account or API key is needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up book metadata from a bookstore and fill reading-note properties automatically.

relations.evidence: The plugin sends search terms to YES24. No account or API key is required.

summary: Searches YES24 by title, author, or ISBN and fills an Obsidian reading note's properties, cover, and book details.
